products.name: St. Jude Mediterranean Tuna, 6oz
products.description: The Malleys are a family business based in Seattle. Joe Malley started out salmon trolling in Sitka, Alaska in 1978. From salmon trolling he moved into longlining, pursuing halibut, blackcod and Pacific cod around the Gulf of Alaska. Presently Joe owns the 95-foot fishing vessel St. Jude, which trolls soley for Albacore tuna in the North and South Pacific. Each fish is caught using hooks and lures, landed and handled individually on a cushioned platform to prevent bruising. The result is an amazing quality tuna packed in it's own juice and nothing else. Perfect for sandwiches, pasta, antipasti, or right out of the can!

products.name: Ati Manel Garfish in Spiced Olive Oil, 120g
products.description:
Ati Manel, originally formed in 1922 by its namesake, exemplified the Portuguese tradition of freshly canned seafood through the late 1950s. When Luís Mendonça, already a successful artist, discovered his great-grandfather’s weathered canning relics more than 60 years after the business passed with Manel into family lore, he was inspired to resurrect the legacy. While researching notes from fishermen and international purveyors, it became clear that close, personal relationships were just as important to Manel as sourcing high quality, local, and raw materials in his tins. Luís has re-captured uniquely distinct flavors and feelings that have set the table again, inviting us all to join the Manel family’s tradition in a tin.

Also known as needlefish, these are similar to sardines and anchovies in many respects but have their own distinct flavor profile and mouthfeel. The best way to understand the difference is to do a tasting, side by side with another species. Or better yet, pick a sardine, a sprat, an anchovy prepared like a sardine, and a garfish. This tin of Ati Manel Garfish are more spicy (plus chilli pepper) than spiced (there’s no clove, bay, or pickled vegetables).

What Makes This Saba Special?

Saba (Japanese mackerel) is known for its hearty flavor and high nutritional value. Unlike milder white fish, it brings a richer bite that stands up well in bold or simple preparations alike. Packed in olive oil, it stays moist and ready to use whenever inspiration strikes.

The olive oil preserves the fish’s tender texture and clean, savory flavor, while the togarashi adds gentle warmth and layered spice from the first bite.

What Makes This Iwashi Special?

Iwashi are prized in Japanese cooking for their soft flake and approachable flavor. Compared to heavier fish, they offer a lighter texture that absorbs seasoning beautifully. The addition of togarashi, a classic Japanese chili blend, brings mild heat and subtle complexity without overpowering the fish.

Sourced from the unspoiled Spanish coastline, this luscious ink boasts a deep, robust taste and vibrant hue that is revered in Mediterranean cooking. An essential ingredient in classic paellas, risottos, pastas, and seafood sauces, Cuttlefish Ink adds a dash of versatility and allure to your kitchen repertoire.

products.name: Donostia Cod Fish in Biscayne Sauce, 111g
products.description:
Cod fish (bacalao) in this style is synonymous with Basque Country. The tinned version is a take on the traditional dish that allows maximum enjoyment of the flavorful offering found at tapas bars across the country in convenient fashion.

The preparation for each tin is simple: the cod is cut, dusted in rice flour and lightly (very lightly, tenderly, gently) fried in olive oil then tinned, with a touch of heat finishing the process.

products.name: Fratelli Polli Italian Antipasto, 7.4oz
products.description: Fratelli Polli is an Italian food company from Milan formed in 1872. They produce a range of preserved vegetables and sauces sold in glass jars. Their Italian Antipasto is a mix of vegetables and tuna in a tomato sauce. It’s excellent served as an appetizer, as a flavorful spread for sandwiches, or add it to a basic marinara sauce and use it as a pasta sauce.

products.name: Iasa Grilled Branzino, 145g
products.description: Branzino can be hard to come by, even if you have a great fish guy. Keep it at the ready safely tucked away in your cupboard until the need arises! This fish is sustainably caught, lightly grilled and hand-packed in olive oil. It's great on grilled bread with a drizzle of good olive oil and a pinch of sea salt, served aloft a pile of fresh greens, or eaten right out of the tin with a fork!

products.name: IASA Spicy Anchovies, 200g
products.description:
Ittica Alimentare Salerno (IASA) packs anchovies caught off the Amalfi Coast, doing most of the work by hand in traditional fashion. They layer the anchovies in drums with sea salt before hand-packing the anchovies in jars. Their Spicy Anchovies are marinated in olive oil and smoky chile paste. The sharp brininess of the fish gets a kick from the pepper yet isn’t overwhelmed by the spiciness. They add zip to dishes like

puttanesca sauce or Caesar dressing, but also make a great appetizer on a piece of crusty bread.

products.description: Les Mouettes d’Arvor hails from the old port town of Concarneau in Brittany. The third-generation cannery is run by the Gonidec family. All their canned fish are fresh, never frozen, caught in a sustainable fashion, and prepared by traditional methods with natural ingredients. Escabeche Sauce is a sweet and sour tomato sauce seasoned with paprika, vinegar, and wine. The delicate mackerel fillets are excellent straight from the tin, over a salad, or as part of a picnic with bread, cheese, and fruit.

products.name: Nettuno Anchovy Colatura, 100ml
products.description: Nettuno is a family-run company founded in 1945 in Cetara, a charming fishing village on the Amalfi coast, on the Gulf of Salerno in Campania. Their production is completely artisanal, inspired by the simple but precise rules of the local anchovy traditions. Colatura di Alici is produced by drawing off the liquid given off by curing anchovies under salt, and is an easy way to add concentrated umami flavor to a dish without having to rinse, filet and chop the little fish. Mix a teaspoon of colatura with a few tablespoons of olive oil and some crushed garlic, and you’ve got an instant flavorful sauce for spaghetti, potatoes, or sauteed greens. Sprinkle a few drops on roasted vegetables, fresh tomatoes, avocado slices, roasted meat, scallops, Caesar salad, and any other dish that could use a quick umami kick! This is the famous Amalfi anchovy sauce.

products.name: Principe di Gerace Mediterranean Anchovies in EVOO, 200g
products.description:
Packed with flavor, these whole anchovies are full of protein, omega-3 fatty acids, and an array of important minerals. Preferably eaten out of the jar, they can also be rinsed in water to eliminate some of the salt and small bones. Use in pasta sauce, Neapolitan style pizza, salads, or any seafood dish.

*2017 Silver sofi Award winner!

products.name: Ramon Pena Big Mussels in Pickled Sauce, 110g
products.description: Ramón Peña's Mussels in Escabeche feature 8-12 plump Galician mussels hand-packed in traditional Spanish pickling liquid. Grown on floating bateas in Rías de Arosa, these meaty mussels are hand-fried, debearded, and preserved in a balanced escabeche of olive oil, vinegar, and spices—delivering authentic tapas bar flavor in every tin.

products.name: Ramon Pena Sardines in Sauce, 130g
products.description: Ramón Peña's Sardines in Sauce follow a generations-old Galician preparation where morning-caught sardines are floured, fried, then tinned in homemade vegetable sauce enriched with wine. The flour-thickened sauce provides hearty body, while the traditional frying method creates firm texture. Best served warm for optimal sauce consistency and flavor.

products.name: Reese Clam Juice, 8oz
products.description: It's hard to find a company that has been making anything since 1947, let alone making clam juice since 1947. You won't always need clam juice, but when you do, nothing else will do. It's all natural briney flavor is the perfect compliment to your world famous clam chowder and all your adventurous cocktails!

products.name: Sclafani Tuna in Olive Oil, 170g
products.description: Sclafani yellow fin tuna has been a DeLaurenti staple for years. It is great quality, pure yellow fin tuna packed in oil. It's what should be in your cupboard at the ready anytime you need a delicious tuna for a sandwich, pasta or appetizer.

products.name: Talatta Anchovies in Olive Oil, 48g

products.name: Talatta Anchovy Paste, 60g
products.description: You won’t use anchovy paste every day, but when you need it, nothing else will do. From Sciacca, Sicily, Talatta is a standard brand here at the store. Just like all their other anchovy products, their paste is of the highest quality. Try it in pasta sauces, salad dressings, tossed roasted vegetables or a quick Bagna Cauda…the options are endless.
